build_regnet_backbone: build a RegNet backbone model using a predefined arch like regnetx_400mf or custom arch dict
run_regnet_forward: run the RegNet forward pass on a PyTorch tensor to get multi-scale feature outputs
generate_regnet_widths: generate per-block widths and stage count from RegNet parameters w0, wa, wm, and depth
adjust_regnet_width_group: adjust the compatibility of stage widths and group widths for RegNet bottleneck layers
get_regnet_stages: get the stage widths and stage block counts from a list of per-block widths
